title: Laptop fire injures passengers on American Airlines flight
summary: A laptop battery caught fire on an American Airlines flight, causing minor burns to five passengers' hands. The incident occurred mid-flight, prompting the pilot to report potential burn injuries. The flight landed safely, and one passenger was treated at the airport. The fire was described as a 'tragic accident'.
summary_points: A laptop battery fire occurred on an American Airlines flight.
Five passengers sustained minor burns to their hands.
The pilot reported possible burn injuries.
The flight landed safely after the incident.
One passenger received treatment at the airport.
